Rina Das: ALERT: INV-2026-0589 ($28,750) marked past due. Customer (Nimbus Health Tech) says invoice disputed due to alleged overage on API calls. They paid partial $7,500 yesterday.
Tom Alvarez: dispute details? are they claiming double-billing or unexpected metering?
Rina Das: claim: usage spike from 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-12 not authorized. They attached CSV of calls.
Priya Menon: CS note 3: customer is in pilot, usage surge aligns with model eval stress tests done by their engineering team. asked them for timestamps of claimed calls.

Sam Carter: Sales says elesign signature required for any payment plan amendment. prefer wire-only to avoid ACH fails.
Collections Bot: [automated] Invoice INV-2026-0589 status: PAST_DUE -> PARTIAL_PAID. Dunning stage: 1. Next automated email scheduled: 2026-04-02.

Tom Alvarez: finance decision: we accept provisional payment plan if we verify disputed usage and receive signed amendment + PO. If usage is found valid, we will require immediate payment for the disputed portion or revert to standard collections.
Rina Das: drafted amendment asking for: acknowledgement of pilot testing, breakdown of disputed dates, wire schedule, and remedy if future disputes found invalid. sending to Sales for signature.
Sam Carter: looping legal: please confirm amendment language is sufficient to waive future dispute on these dates.
Collections Bot: [automated] Note added to invoice INV-2026-0589: reconciliation in progress, hold dunning after docs are received.
Priya Menon: uploaded matched usage spreadsheet to shared drive and pinged Nimbus with our findings. waiting on their confirmation.
Tom Alvarez: leaving final note: if Nimbus doesn't sign amendment by 2026-04-07, move to escalation path and reactivate dunning.
